blocks.label: code-parser watcher + v11/v12 bench
blocks.gist: The code-parser architecture was inspected to confirm that the CLI generates a full JSONL snapshot while the watcher provides incremental, stream-based updates for changed files without modifying existing data in place.

blocks.label: pi-codemap jev + consolidation + decider
blocks.gist: Refactored v12.1 to replace custom Jev transport with pi's official registry, deleting 250 lines of credential and login code while preserving custom judgment logic.

blocks.label: typellm research + per-repo keys
blocks.gist: Established TypeLLM as a first-class provider alongside Jev, leveraging its `depends_on` DAG feature to enable complex, multi-step decision trees in a single API call.

blocks.label: routing phase 1/2 + virtual model
blocks.gist: Discovered and fixed a critical contract bug where codemap tools returned strings instead of arrays, causing 100% tool call failures, then re-ran a clean 18-run evaluation to measure the true benefits of codemap+jev and codemap+typellm versus pi-alone.

blocks.label: docs + PII audit
blocks.gist: Documented the codemap/auto routing mechanism in the README and scrubbed PII (username and local paths) from the pi-codemap repository.

blocks.label: infinite-chat brainstorm
blocks.gist: Brainstormed a 'topic memory' extension for pi that uses TypeLLM for topic classification and a side-car index to manage context without invalidating the KV cache.

blocks.label: morph divergent research + product tension
blocks.gist: Validated that Morph's custom block architecture is superior to reveal.js's stringly-typed HTML comment approach, confirming the hypothesis that reveal.js did not solve custom blocks but rather worked around their absence with fragile regex-based DOM manipulation.

blocks.label: morph plans + settings modal
blocks.gist: Evaluated @preact/signals-core against the CSMA runtime, determining they are distinct layers where signals should be adopted for product-layer UI state while strictly excluding them from the zero-dependency Layer 0 core.

blocks.label: morph ship 007 + design skill port + outline search
blocks.gist: Shipped MorphEditor 007 and identified the root cause of the depth-2 tool mangling as a fuzzy agent-file matcher in pi-core-subagent that incorrectly overrides explicit tool configurations with mismatched frontmatter definitions.

blocks.label: morph export/android + sidebar polish
blocks.gist: Fixed the RTL implementation by correcting the mode conflation bug where explicit direction settings were being overridden by per-block auto-detection, ensuring text direction now properly respects the document setting.

blocks.label: morph plan reviews + subagent fleet + sync gateway
blocks.gist: Item 14 completed by consolidating push sites, porting the history module to Morph, and implementing serialization with block-id remapping to ensure undo/redo survives app restarts.

blocks.label: morph glm subagent impl + contracts error + diff bug
blocks.gist: TASK 1 (re1-small-moves) was merged to main after passing all review gates, and TASK 2 (re2-documents-export) is currently in progress with the worker having completed file moves and passing initial test gates.

blocks.label: morph task-list comments + columns html
blocks.gist: Approved Plan 023 v2, adding reactions and cross-document bookmarks to the existing badge and menu tasks, and generated five corresponding specification contracts.

blocks.label: morph calendar fix + sidebar markdown
blocks.gist: Decided to reuse the existing Formbar calendar UI for the inline AtPopover to ensure visual consistency, identifying that the primary missing feature to implement is the '+ End date' range selection capability.
